title: Lodestone is worth it!
description: Returns old and fair lodestone recipe with netherite.
body:
From version 1.21.5, you need an iron ingot to craft a lodestone instead of a netherite one. I find this unfair and devalues ​​such a useful block. You can also find plenty of lodestones in ruined portal chests, so making them cheaper to craft is just unfair, as I said.

### This datapack returns an old crafting recipe with a netherite ingot.

![crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9edc637b69da59cf1438b717a3deeedd852ad99a.png)

_Maybe I will backport this for 1.21.5-1.21.10 and 26.1 in a few days._ Upd.: done ✅
